title: events/types/action.issued
description: Payload for event_type 'action.issued' (native type, feature 004; FR-307): a validated action was accepted by the single-writer dispatcher and the bridge RPC is about to run. Every accepted write emits this before any call (SC-301: event stream == write stream).

decision_id.description: Typed-decision id when the action was model-sourced; absent for reflex/operator actions.
